address: Rua dos Navegantes 53 B, Lisbon, 1200-731, Portugal
bio: In this restaurant, located just a few steps from the 18C Baroque Basílica da Estrela, they are keen to highlight their connection with micro-seasonal ingredients to maximise the flavour of each one and to meet their zero-waste criteria. Loco is full of surprises as soon as you step through the door, starting with the bright, completely open-view kitchen and enhanced by its extensive designer features that reflect its creativity and character. Head chef Alexandre Silva’s culinary philosophy is fully focused on a single surprise tasting menu comprising 16 “moments” or courses, which takes its inspiration from Portuguese tradition, while at the same time constantly evolving from a contemporary perspective.
